title: Tantra MCP connector catalog
description: Verified facts about vendor MCP servers that Tantra can propose connecting. Every entry is a claim with sources and a verification date; the tantra-connect skill re-verifies any entry older than 60 days and never invents an endpoint, package or tool name. This file is read by .claude/lib/mcp_connector_registry.py (propose --catalog-id) to fill the approval card and flag drift between a proposal and the verified entry.

id.description: Stable catalog id; also the suggested --server name.

display_name.description: Shown on the approval card's 'Connects' line.

official.description: true only when the vendor itself publishes and maintains the server.

url.description: Remote endpoint for http/sse. https only.

command.description: stdio launcher, e.g. npx or uvx.

package.description: Version-pinned package for stdio servers, e.g. @vendor/mcp-server@1.2.3 or vendor-mcp==0.4.1.

env_vars.description: Names of the environment variables the server needs. Names only, never values.

headers.description: Header templates, values as ${VAR} references only.

write_tools.description: Tools that create, update, delete, send or trigger anything in the live system.

tools_complete.description: true when read_tools + write_tools is the server's full tool list as of verified_at.

cost_note.description: Plain statement of plan/tier requirements or 'free' -- shown verbatim on the approval card.

suggested_agents.description: Tantra agents whose work the read tools feed (informational; frontmatter is never edited automatically).

sources.description: Vendor-official docs pages the entry was verified against.

verified_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the last verification against sources.
